description: This file contains a class that compiles the {include_php} tag for the Smarty templating engine. It handles the compilation of PHP code inclusion within templates by translating template tags into executable PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include_Php
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {include_php} Smarty tag into PHP code, enabling inclusion of PHP scripts within Smarty templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to include a PHP file as specified by the {include_php} tag in Smarty templates, handling security and assignment options.
